profile.bio: 3D artist & creative director based in Tokyo. Specialising in character art, game assets, and real-time visuals.

works.title: Akali
works.description: High-detail 3D character model. Sculpted with focus on anatomy, silhouette, and surface texture. An exploration of game-art aesthetics translated into a full 3D asset — balancing stylisation with structural believability.

works.title: Cone
works.description: A geometric study in pure form. Exploring the language of primitives as a foundation for more complex structures.

works.title: Cube
works.description: A geometric study in pure form. The cube as a starting point — a meditation on mass and edge.

works.title: Ico
works.description: Icosphere geometry. Uniform triangulation distributed across a sphere — a recurring motif in computational form.
